items.finding: The native client removes supplied generic factory helpers and assembles its own fixed policy/bootstrap. Retain shared factories; removing interfaces would break other clients. Custom assembly is not a replacement for generic support.
items.requiredInterfaceOrCounterexample: Shared factory hooks must preserve owned account/kind/namespace/native identity and explicit trusted stage boundaries.

items.finding: Direct accessionCode/caption fields and labels.fingerprint imports are museum-specific. GET inspection changes persisted state; exact reviewer acknowledgement is distinct from server delivery of a representation. Readiness checks contain a fixed schema1 literal.
items.requiredInterfaceOrCounterexample: Use versioned intake/representation/review policy interfaces and one shared schema admission helper. Any inspection acknowledgement must bind current source/result/revision/policy, actor/account and live role; a GET is not proof a human read it.

items.finding: SELECT/INSERT on review_inspections applies only when that explicit policy/table exists. Do not grant a nonexistent table or infer all workflows need it.
items.requiredInterfaceOrCounterexample: Version schema/grants together; retain no membership administration, schema migration or audit/history deletion authority for runtime identities.

items.finding: Native code replaces model_unavailable with processing_unavailable for deterministic work. The generic failure-state and replay semantics are unchanged; classify processor failures without implying AI use.
items.requiredInterfaceOrCounterexample: If extracted, preserve old observed reason codes/history and prove temporary/permanent/uncertain behavior across deterministic/model adapters.

items.finding: Unicode storage was independently repaired in shared schema2, not copied verbatim. Native labels imports, source-derived validation and ordinary-staff own-read policy must not become global domain assumptions. Inspection receipt uses actor/revision/fingerprint; scope/privacy choices need explicit contracts.
items.requiredInterfaceOrCounterexample: Provide versioned owned validation/read-scope/review interfaces with approval-binding and rollback evidence; test private versus collaborative policies, both derived-field directions, live revocation, foreign-account/cursor/history access and stale inspection races.

items.finding: Native UID65534/65533 drop occurs only when parent is root. Nonroot execution silently retains one UID. Copying this would imply a credential/process isolation guarantee it cannot provide on every platform or runtime.
items.requiredInterfaceOrCounterexample: Any privilege policy must be trusted operator configuration, explicit platform/capability admission and fail closed when unavailable. Verify parent protection, groups/capabilities/FDs/credentials and actual image behavior. ProcessStage currently promises deadlines, not hostile-code isolation.

items.finding: Shared schema2 now stores canonical UTF8 JSON source/result/history/receipt with exact version/hash admission. Native inspection table remains a client specialization with its own schema/grant/retention obligations.
items.requiredInterfaceOrCounterexample: Do not adopt native schema1 or copy a new table into existing databases. Any future receipt mechanism needs tenant/actor/revision/policy constraints, bounded retention/lifecycle and explicit migration review.

scope: Source/interface review plus previously recorded local image evidence. Proposed generic interfaces are not implemented or newly accepted client requirements.
completedGenericExtraction: canonical Unicode JSON persistence and exact schema2 admission, independently qualified separately
